## Requirements
Requirement id to satisfy + stamp: **R-2.1.6** (§8.2) — the resource-economics & accounting
model. Stage-1 slice (§8.2 §9 + ticket goal): the full kernel dimension list;
`control.budget.{allocated,reserved,consumed,released,exceeded,amended}` and
`measurement.cost.attributed` payloads; `Attribution`; `PricingTable` schema;
`cost_totals` view; `usage_mapping` golden tests; dynamic containment; soft thresholds as
`HarnessRule`s; `MatchSpec`/`search_budget`/`eval_budget`/results-row fields; exhaustion
rules E1–E5; one root `BudgetNode`; `Reservation`. Spec-staged later (NOT this ticket):
`env.*`/`network.*` producers (Stage 2), `amend` live retune drivers (C1), delegation by
`spawn` (C1/Stage 4), hosted boundary budgets (C2/Stage 4), M1/M2 engine reporting and the
exhaustion battery at Stage 3, M3 gate execution (C4/Stage 6), pricing governance (C1).

## Acceptance criteria (gating, deterministic)
AC-R-2.1.6-{2,3,4,7,13}:
- AC-2 canonical roles: golden usage payloads in each provider dialect lower to the
  canonical exclusive decomposition (`input.total = uncached + cache_read + cache_write`)
  under the declared `usage_mapping`; two independent `attribute_spend` implementations
  agree to the micro-unit.
- AC-3 nothing unaccounted: ≥1 charge per accountable event class; zero orphans;
  instrument + subject totals equal raw totals.
- AC-4 containment/conservation: pool children never overshoot the parent; slice child
  ceiling ≤ parent remaining at allocation, remainder released on completion; allocate
  refusals ledgered.
- AC-7 idempotent charging on `(source_event, dimension)`.
- AC-13 governance: `budget_delta = loosening` rejected in evolution contexts; child amend
  beyond parent remaining → `AuthorityInsufficient`; approvals exhaustion converts
  `ask → deny`, ledger shows no allow.

Non-gating ACs landed at schema/logic level (stage assignment): AC-1 (baseline slice,
already exercised by hh-baseline), AC-5/-6 (Stage-3 battery — the `check`/`exhaust` rules
they pin are landed and unit-tested), AC-8/-9 (Stage-3 reporting — the provenance/
confidence/coverage fields and `validate_match` refusals are landed and unit-tested),
AC-10 (Stage-3 T-LCD-13 chain — `advise` + once-per-window/re-arm landed), AC-11 (Stage 2),
AC-12 (C4 gate — schema + refusal landed).

## Plan
1. `hh-ontology::dimensions` — the closed kernel `DimensionId` registry (24 counters +
   3 gauges + registered `ext.*`), `DimensionClass`, `DimensionKey` (primary | derived),
   `DerivedDimension` (`tokens.input.total`/`tokens.output.total`/`tokens.blended`,
   formula-derived, never stored primary). Vocabulary lives in the ontology crate so
   `hh-hir` (already a dependent) can check `Budget.dimensions` keys — closes DF-S1.4-1
   without a layering inversion.
2. `hh-hir`: `validate` checks `BudgetRecord` dimension keys against the registry
   (`SchemaViolation` on unknown); budget_within/diff unchanged.
3. `hh-ledger::classes`: register `control.budget.*` (6 rows), `control.decision`,
   `measurement.cost.attributed` (all kernel-origin, ledger durability, not audit-grade —
   absent from the §5a.1 §6 audit list), `verification.validator.invoked` (plain row —
   §05f owns its final flags).
4. New persistent crate `crates/hh-budget` (deps: wire/identity/provenance/ontology/
   ledger/hir): `quantity` (ResourceQuantity/Vector/MeteringFormula/Money), `usage`
   (UsageMapping/dialects/decompose/TokenVector), `attribution` (Attribution/ChargedTo/
   R-ACC-3 producer table), `pricing` (PricingTable/SpendRow/CostProvenance/Confidence/
   coverage ppm), `spec` (Ceiling/Threshold/BudgetSpec/BudgetNode/Reservation),
   `events` (payload builders+decoders, StopReason members), `tree` (pure projection —
   the in-memory form the baseline adapts to), `account` (the ledger-bound ops),
   `matchspec` (MatchSpec/ArmSpec/validate_match/refusal sum), `governance`
   (evolution-context budget_delta gate).
5. `hh-baseline`: `budget.rs` becomes a thin adapter over `hh_budget` — one scheme (CC1).
   Charges post to primary roles (`tokens.input.uncached`, `tokens.output.visible`);
   `tokens.blended` is the derived bound.
6. Tests: unit per module; `tests/acceptance.rs` = the AC matrix; `tests/golden_usage.rs`
   = dialect goldens + two-implementation micro-unit agreement.

## Owned decisions / deviations (→ ADR-0236…)
- `DimensionId` registry homed in `hh-ontology` (vocabulary crate) so `hh-hir` closes
  DF-S1.4-1 without layering inversion; `hh-budget` re-exports (CC7 single source).
- `DimensionKey = primary | derived` — derived bound keys (`tokens.blended` &c.) evaluate
  by their fixed `MeteringFormula`; derived dims are never chargeable (never stored
  primary). Needed so the Stage-0 `tokens.blended` ceiling migrates without a second scheme.
- Containment predicate mirrors HIR `DimensionBound::within`: a child bound on a
  parent-unbounded dimension is refused (child bounds ⊆ parent bounds, ≤ remaining).
- `Money` micro-units; `coverage`/`tolerance` as parts-per-million integers (canonical
  JSON has no floats; exact, never lossy).
- `allocate` refusal ledgered as `control.budget.allocated{outcome: refused, refusal{…}}`
  (the family is closed — the refusal rides the same class).
- `exhaust` E1 is conservative: refuses `EffectsInFlight` while ANY unresolved effect
  exists; the `read_only` exemption refines when the effect risk class is a payload field
  (R-2.2.2/S1.7) → DF-S1.6-1.
- `advise` dedup ledgered via `context.observation.recorded{kind:"budget_reminder"}` (the
  §05c `context.artefact.*`/`verification.artefact.followed` chain is Stage-3; the re-arm
  rule already reads `context.compaction.completed` spellings in the projection).
- Grace (E3) claims ledgered as `control.decision{kind:"grace_call"}`; approvals ask→deny
  ledgered as `security.permission.decided{decision: deny, reason: approvals_exhausted}`.
- `control.decision`/`control.budget.*`/`measurement.cost.attributed` registered
  kernel-origin, not audit-grade (absent from §5a.1 §6's audit list — interim ruling like
  ADR-0234's).

## Evidence report
**R-2.1.6 Stage-1 slice landed.** `hh-budget` (new persistent crate) is the one
canonical resource-economics/accounting scheme: the closed kernel dimension registry
(`hh-ontology::dimensions`), exclusive token-role decomposition under declared
`usage_mapping` dialects, `Attribution`/`charged_to`, `PricingTable`-derived spend rows
carrying provenance/confidence/coverage/derivation/`pricing_ref` (never a raw number;
`NoPrice`/`MixedCurrency` are typed refusals), the ledger-bound `Account` over the
`control.budget.*` family + `control.decision` + `measurement.cost.attributed`, the
hierarchical `BudgetTree` (one root, `slice`/`pool` containment, affine reservations,
ancestor propagation, `cost_totals`/`accountability_report`), exhaustion E1–E5, the
`MatchSpec`/M1/M2/M3 refusal sum, and the `budget_delta` evolution gate.
`hh-baseline`'s throwaway budget is a thin adapter over these types — one scheme (CC1).

Gating ACs (AC-R-2.1.6-{2,3,4,7,13}) all executable and green:
- **AC-2** — `tests/golden_usage.rs`: golden payloads in both provider dialects lower to
  the canonical exclusive decomposition (`input.total = uncached + cache_read +
  cache_write` by construction); the same decomposition priced by `price`/
  `attribute_spend` and by an independently-coded reference pricer agrees to the
  micro-unit. (The cross-*candidate* half is DF-S1.2-2's corpus extension — Stage 3.)
- **AC-3** — `accountability_reports_orphans_and_clean_runs`: every accountable event
  has ≥1 charge; `instrument` + `subject` totals equal raw; orphans reported, never
  dropped.
- **AC-4** — `child_within_parent_allocates_over_budget_refuses`,
  `reserve_charge_release_conserve`, `charge_is_idempotent_and_propagates_to_ancestors`,
  `one_root_per_run_and_refusals_are_ledgered`: containment holds, conservation is
  affine, refusals are ledgered on the same classes.
- **AC-7** — idempotent charge on `(source_event, dimension)`; re-projection after a
  crash replays cleanly (`rebuild_from_the_ledger_matches_the_incremental_projection`).
- **AC-13** — `amend_respects_the_authority_table` (child amend beyond parent remaining
  → `AuthorityInsufficient`), `approvals_exhaustion_converts_ask_to_deny` (ledgered deny,
  no allow), `governance` unit tests (evolution-context `loosening` refused; human/
  migration origins may loosen).
E1–E5 each have a dedicated integration test (`e1_*`, `e3_*`, `e4_*`, `e5_*` +
`over_reservation_is_charged_and_flagged`); MatchSpec refusals (`unbudgeted`,
`incommensurable`, `missing_pricing_table`, `missing_match_spec`, mixed cache policy,
advisory-enforcement `matched_cap`, exploratory `mode:none`) are unit-tested.
